source_crs: EPSG:3857 (WKID 102100/latestWKID 3857, established from retained feature-layer metadata; feature geometry response omits spatialReference)

local_transform.axes: X east, Y north, Z up
local_transform.units: meters; local project approximation, not a surveyed CRS

raw_shape_units: undocumented; not used for ground area or perimeter
vertical_interpretation: Unresolved. No height units, vertical datum or complete field semantics supplied by the retained feature-layer metadata. Do not interpret Extrution=39 or Elevation=623 as measured metres.

imagery_export.orientation: north-up; x east and y north
imagery_export.capture_date: not supplied in exported tile; imagery mosaicked from multiple providers
imagery_export.limitations: Trees, roof shadows, mixed-resolution imagery and unknown acquisition date limit roof-feature interpretation; overlay only checks broad source-ring position, not wall line.
